name: Citizenship by Descent

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent is a Jamaican citizen (by birth, descent, naturalisation, or registration) at the time relevant to the claim.

evidence_required.document: Parent's proof of Jamaican citizenship (birth certificate, citizenship/naturalisation certificate, or passport)
JMD 5,000 / USD 100 / CAD 110 / GBP 60 / EUR 74 fee

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (PICA), Jamaica -- Citizenship by Descent: application for a person with a Jamaican-citizen parent, fees JMD 5,000 / USD 100 / CAD 110 / GBP 60 / EUR 74 depending on where filed, 6-12 months processing
Jamaica Information Service (JIS) -- Jamaican Nationality Act: Section 4 frames descent-based citizenship primarily around the registration of minor children born abroad to a Jamaican-citizen parent

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both sources tier-1. UNRESOLVED TENSION BETWEEN TWO TIER-1 SOURCES, DISCLOSED RATHER THAN RESOLVED: the Jamaican Nationality Act's own text (Section 4) reads as primarily concerned with registering MINOR children born abroad to a Jamaican-citizen parent, while PICA's own operational descent-application page and process treat 'Citizenship by Descent' as a general-purpose route open to applicants of any age with a Jamaican-citizen parent. This dataset models PICA's practical/operational framing since that is what applicants actually encounter, but flags that the statutory text may be narrower than PICA's guidance suggests -- worth a legal read of the full Act text if precision matters. 'REGISTRATION OF MINORS' (PICA form R4, JMD 5,000, ~24 months processing) is a related but administratively distinct PICA service for registering a child born abroad to a Jamaican parent as a citizen -- folded into this file's notes rather than built as a separate route, since it is a sub-procedure of the same underlying descent right rather than a distinct eligibility pathway.
